name: 49512 · Grand Rapids, MI
findings: ZIP 49512 (Grand Rapids) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49512 (Grand Rapids) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49512 (Grand Rapids) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
